I couldn't come up with a description so here's my pizza order:
Large pizza with pepperoni, mushrooms, Italian sausage, green Olives, banana peppers, bacon, onions
If I'm feeling extra hungry, sometimes I'll also get garlic twists.
But on other days I feel like I want a burger rather than a pizza.
In that case, my usual burger has like, lettuce, tomato, cheese, pickles, onions, mustard, ketchup, and mayo.
Sometimes I'll add bacon or avocado if I'm feeling fancy.
Usually I get fries on the side, but I also don't mind a good order of cheese curds.
To drink, I usually go for a soda, like a cola or root beer.
And for dessert, I have a weakness for chocolate chip cookies or a brownie sundae.
